name: dsh-vivy-console
description: Vivy Studio first-party console: 总控台 (main console) — one-click start/stop/restart of the unified development loop (pure-API vivy_headless backend + Vite dev server :3015) with backend/frontend status and one unified log timeline; plus a separate 打包与版本 page (packaging & version management via vivy-studio.exe: pack/eval/release/install/rollback + ledger), deliberately distinct from dev mode
